structured.answer: Probably an S&P 500 tracker at a name I know (Meitav, Harel or Menora). They all show about 13–14% over 3 years and around 0.5–0.6% fees, but I didn't open anything today and I'm not sure which one.

stuck.where: Small rings next to each track
stuck.why: 'מניות 99%' and 'מט"ח 99%' together make 198%, sometimes 'מניות 101%'. I couldn't tell what the ring shows and guessed teal = shares, yellow = מט"ח
The same row repeats over and over with nearly the same S&P numbers, and nothing tells me which one to pick. That's where I'd have closed it
Many rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, e.g. Altshuler's S&P, which has a low fee, so I couldn't compare
Two fees per row, 'ההחיסכון' and 'ההפקדה'. I didn't get the difference and only looked at the first one

S&P 500 tracker rows: fee 'ההחיסכון' and '3 שנים' return (Harel 0.56%/13.7%, Meitav 0.6%/13.87%, Menora 0.52%/13.79%, Altshuler 0.54%)
skimmed: Bond and mixed tracks (אשראי ואג"ח, כללי, משולב סחיר)

findings.what: Too many near-identical rows (143) with no recommendation. I ended up doing nothing
Each row repeats the same labels (ההחיסכון/ההפקדה, 3 שנים/5 שנים, מניות/מט"ח), so I re-read them every time to find the difference
Ring percentages add up to 198% or show 101%, and the colors are only explained by tiny dots
Fees only as small percents, nothing in shekels, so 0.52% vs 0.71% feels the same
Orange banner 'נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026' looks like a warning and lowers trust
'פחות מ־3 שנים' and 'עוד לא דווח' with orange ! icons scare me off rows that may be cheap
findings.where: Many rows, e.g. Altshuler S&P, Ayalon

findings.what: S&P tracker isn't grouped together. I had to hunt for it in every company
